title: Iterated and product $L^p$ norms
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\lambda$ be a probability law on $\Omega$, let $n$ be a natural number, let $p>0$, and let $f:\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$. The iterated $L^p$ norm of $f$ with respect to $\lambda$ in each coordinate equals its $L^p$ norm under the product law on $\Omega^n$.
